newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Deutsche M. Grenfell cuts Danish 97 c/a.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Deutsche M. Grenfell cuts Danish 97 c/a.

text.p: In its latest survey Deutsche Morgan Grenfell on Thursday lowered its expectations for Denmark's 1997 current account surplus to 12 billion crowns from 13 billion crowns in its last forecast in January.
At the same time it left unchanged its previous estimate of 2.8 percent GDP (gross domestic product) growth but lifted its and 1997 inflation forecast to 2.4 percent from 2.3 percent.

The latest Danish Economy Ministry forecast in December foresaw 2.9 percent GDP growth, 2.3 percent inflation, 8.0 percent unemployment and a current account surplus of 13.0 billion crowns for this year.
The following estimates were made by 10 leading local and international organisations.
